name: Emilia Solva
source:
She is the leader of the Knights of St. Bernard, an order of pure maidens who are followers of the goddess Larenthia.

Although there are only female members, their abilities are genuine, and Emilia, the leader of the order, is so skilled in military prowess that she is rumored to be a “brave warrior with a spear."

For Emilia, who values justice and integrity, the service state is nothing more than a crucible for vice. In order to save the oppressed women, she rides into the country of service.

[From [url=http://liquid.nexton-net.jp/liq40/spin.html]official site[/url]]
